question: Kuchipudi is a classical dance form of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kuchipudi:

 
 
• Kuchipudi is a major classical dance form of India that originated in a village of the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Kuchipudi involves different foot movements and is generally a team performance.
 
• The central them of Kuchipudi is Bhagavata puran.
 
• The dancers of Kuchipudi came to be known as Bhagavathalus.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kathakali:

 
 
• Kathakali is a classical Indian dance form which is a story play genre of art and is the folk dance form of Kerala.
 
• It is a 'story play' genre of art, but one distinguished by the elaborately colorful make-up, costumes, and face masks that the traditionally male actor-dancers wear.
 
 
 
• Bharatnatyam:
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is the oldest and major classical dance form of India that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It traces its origins back to the Natyashastra, ancient treaties on theatre written by the mythic priest Bharata.
 
 

 
• 'Yakshagana' is a famous dance-drama performed in the coastal areas of Karnataka.
